supporting_citations.quote: Meridian Support Service uses passwordless email links for operator sign-in. A sign-in link expires after fifteen minutes and can be used only once.
Service tokens are for server-to-server integrations only. Store them in a secret manager and rotate a token immediately if it appears in a client log.
The case search page has a monthly availability objective of 99.5 percent. Scheduled maintenance is announced at least forty-eight hours in advance and is excluded from that objective.
Submitting the same import key within twenty-four hours returns the original import result. Corrected data must use a new import key.
The import preview rejects rows with a missing case_id or an opened_at value that is not ISO 8601. Rejected rows remain available for download for seven days.
The Viewer role can search cases and download approved reports. Viewers cannot change case ownership, export raw attachments, or edit routing rules.
New cases are routed by customer_region and issue category. A case marked billing is assigned to the Finance queue; a case marked security is assigned to the Security Response queue.
If no routing rule matches, the case enters the General Review queue. Operators must assign General Review cases within one business day.
Publish a customer-facing update every sixty minutes while a confirmed outage remains active. Close an incident only after the service is stable and follow-up work has an owner.
Quality review scores are internal operational signals. They are not a customer satisfaction measurement.
Notifications do not contain attachment text or access tokens. Operators open the case in Meridian to view details.

supporting_citations.quote: Deletion requests are processed nightly. The audit event records the request identifier, object type, and completion time, but never stores the deleted summary text.

supporting_citations.quote: Case summaries and routing history are retained for 365 days after a case closes. Approved reports are retained for 90 days after generation.
An export link expires after twenty-four hours. Downloading an export creates an audit event with the report identifier and operator identifier.
The ingestion worker retries a transient downstream failure up to three times using exponential backoff. A failed final attempt creates a case for General Review.
The notification service deduplicates notifications by event identifier for thirty days. A delivery failure is retried twice before it is recorded for follow-up.
